research.title: Probability Calibration Under Class-Prior Shift
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare temperature scaling and isotonic calibration under controlled changes in classification class priors.
Evaluated calibration error and predictive loss across resampled test distributions, examining sensitivity to calibration set composition and minority class representation.

research.title: Covariate Shift and Weighted Conformal Regression
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance comparing standard and importance-weighted conformal prediction for regression under synthetic covariate shifts.
Implemented density ratio estimation baselines and evaluated interval coverage and width, examining sensitivity to weight clipping and calibration sample composition.

publications.title: Weight Estimation and Clipping in Conformal Regression Under Covariate Shift

work.title: Batch Data Validation and Processing
bullets: Implemented validation checks for batch data imports, handling missing fields, duplicate records, and inconsistent date formats before downstream processing.
Added regression tests for parsing failures and updated error messages to support diagnosis of rejected imports and routine maintenance.

projects.title: Regularized Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge, lasso, and elastic net regression pipelines with standardized predictors and cross-validation for selecting regularization parameters.
Compared predictive error and coefficient stability across simulated correlation structures, documenting how predictor dependence affected variable selection.

projects.title: Approximate Inference for Bayesian Logistic Regression
bullets: Implemented Laplace and mean-field variational approximations for Bayesian logistic regression using a shared Gaussian prior and consistent preprocessing.
Compared held-out predictive loss, posterior uncertainty, and computational behavior across datasets with varying feature correlations and class overlap.
